tips.title: Eka- the doer
body: **Eka-** makes a word for the person who does something: **ekaswamaran** farmer, **ekayaran** cook, **ekasuaman** worker. The plural is **ika-**.

tips.title: Isuamai aswam ŋinyo?
body: **Isuamai aswam ŋinyo?** asks “what work do you do?”. Answer **Eoŋ ka…** (I am…): **Eoŋ ka ekaswamaran**.

culture.title: Farming in Teso
body: Most families farm millet, sorghum, cassava, groundnuts, cotton and citrus. Soroti oranges are famous across Uganda.
